demo: force-start control test for the NuExtract skill pair
question: the patch rarely flips the first-token gate (1 of 10 unforced). If the start is forced, does the plain base complete the extraction (skill already in the base; the patch mainly moves the trigger), or does the patch complete much better (the patch carries skill beyond the trigger)?
finetuned_model: numind/NuExtract-1.5-tiny (MIT), full fine-tune of the base
skill_rule: answer parses as JSON, keys match the template, every expected value present
decoding: fine-tune's own first generated token forced, then greedy, max 64 new tokens including the forced one, raw NuExtract prompt format
forced_token_source: greedy argmax of the fine-tune's own weights after each prompt, cross-checked as a prefix of the recorded full-delta answer in results/skill_demo.json
